basic_info.description: Welcome to 363 Prague Street - your perfect start in San Francisco's vibrant Excelsior neighborhood.    This beautifully updated home offers the ideal blend of modern living and neighborhood charm, perfect for first-time buyers ready to settle into city life. Upstairs, discover three spacious bedrooms (rear bedroom is staged as a dining room) and 1.5 baths surrounding a stunning, fully remodeled kitchen - the heart of the home. With sleek stainless steel appliances, a large island with bar seating, new flooring, and abundant natural light from a large skylight, it's a space designed for everything from casual breakfasts to memorable dinner parties. The open-concept living area, complete with recessed lighting, offers a cozy yet spacious feel - perfect for relaxing after a busy day. Downstairs, you'll find a flexible 4th bedroom ideal for a home office, gym, or guest space, plus a brand-new full bathroom and generous storage. A large garage with laundry, additional storage, and access to the expansive backyard makes day-to-day living effortless. ​With nearby parks, schools, public transit, and local shops, 363 Prague offers the comfort of a neighborhood vibe with the convenience of urban access. Bright, welcoming, and move-in ready--this is Excelsior living at its best.
